related_not_counted: Positive integer multiples of a primitive solution: imprimitive because gcd>1.
Permutations of the four summands and equivalent transfers of signed terms across the equality are not new primitive identities.
Exponent 4 solutions and equations with five or more positive fifth-power summands are different Diophantine problems.
Signed five-fifth-power equations equal to 1 (or other non-fifth-power targets) are not in this zero-residual equation.
Solutions with zero terms and trivial cancelling +x^5 and -x^5 are excluded by this nontrivial nonzero five-base scope.
